title: Gurukul AI：面向印度教育体系的交互式AI驱动教育平台
summary: 针对印度教育体系，基于NCERT教材构建了包含18,720个问答对的数据集，微调LLaMA 3.1 8B模型，并部署于RAG框架，推出支持英语和印地语的开放平台GurukulAI，帮助学生答疑、练习考试题目，弥合全球LLM与区域教育需求之间的差距。
summary_en: Targeting the Indian education system, this work curates a syllabus-aligned QA dataset from NCERT textbooks, fine-tunes LLaMA 3.1 8B, and deploys it in a RAG framework to create GurukulAI, an open platform supporting English and Hindi for doubt clearing and exam practice.
